Definition: support (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) sustenance or (concretely) a walking-stick
BiblicalUsage: The word is a staff, a walking-stick and a support, and its uses run from comfort to false trust. The shepherd's staff comforts in the valley of the shadow of death, Isaiah says God will take away the stay and the staff from Jerusalem, and Egypt is called a staff of reed that breaks in the hand of any man who leans on it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the staff is only as strong as the hand that holds it: lean on the Shepherd's staff and it comforts, lean on Egypt's reed and it breaks in your hand.
